title: WinWinCode Control Plane HTTP Command and Query Contract
description: Canonical browser and external-client HTTP boundary. Business writes use CommandRequest; WebSocket is projection-only.

inputResponse.identityJoin: payload.sessionIdentity must equal the accepted SessionBinding identity

enterpriseIdentity.tokenFormat: wwc_api_<26-character ApiTokenId suffix>.<43-character unpadded base64url encoding of exactly 32 random bytes>

candidateReviewRead.authority: exact Delivery cursor plus verified append-only Delivery journal, candidate Artifact, controlled Git source, and durable candidate retention receipt
candidateReviewRead.readCursorReplay: readPageLimit must equal the page.limit used to issue atCursor
candidateReviewRead.historyAvailability: available only for an exact pinned retention; released is display-only and never authorizes Git content reads
candidateReviewRead.historicalReviewAuthorization: historical Verdict and Evidence are display-only and never become current Delivery authorization

modelRouteAvailability.scopeAuthority: exact repository query scope; inherited settings and catalog scopes are joined only by the server

AuthSessionRequest.description: Versioned, credential-free browser-session mutation body. Bootstrap proof and session cookie remain transport-only.

AuthSessionResponse.description: Secret-free current browser-session context. Scopes are bounded, current, and ordered by canonical scope identity.

OpaqueCursor.description: Opaque cursor bound to scope, query, filters, and one stable snapshot.

QueryEnvelope.description: Side-effect-free query. Authenticated identity must equal actor and authorize scope.

CommandCompletedResponse.description: Exact command/result response union. Relabeling a result under another command is invalid.

QueryResultResponse.description: Exact query/result response union. A client can narrow result by query without accepting an unrelated projection.

CredentialReferenceProjection.description: Secret-safe lifecycle metadata only: responses never include secret material or vault locator.

InputRespondPayload.description: Control Plane validates the complete binding before emitting one ExecutionPort input.response.

reviewSetSha256.description: Stale-check assertion for the current sealed approved SolutionReviewProjection; it is not caller-authored task content.

DeliveryApproveTaskBreakdownPayload.description: Promotes the ordered task proposals from the exact sealed approved review set. The caller cannot submit or replace task fields.

candidateDigest.description: Current frozen candidate digest used for stale-check only; it is not Evidence, a verdict, or an authorization fact.

DeliverySubmitVerdictPayload.description: Requests server-side verdict computation from sealed Control Plane facts. Caller-derived Evidence, criterion results, verdicts, Attention, status, credentials, verification conclusions, and raw runtime facts are rejected.

CredentialReferenceRotatePayload.description: Binds an already-atomically-rotated secret-store version to lifecycle metadata. The locator is write-only and is never persisted in the Credential reference aggregate.

atCursor.description: Optional server-issued cursor for an exact replay. Omit it to establish a new bounded StrongFlow read cut.

allOf.description: Repository-scoped stale-check request. The authenticated actor, complete repository scope, requestId, and expectedRevision form the command boundary.

PublicationProjection.description: Bounded publication summary joined to one current Delivery, Spec, candidate, passing verdict, approval, and target. Remote resources use a closed GitHub identity, never an arbitrary URL or provider payload.

GitHubRepositorySlug.description: GitHub owner/repository without URL syntax, userinfo, query, fragment, or credentials.

PublicationResourceRef.description: Secret-safe remote publication identity. Control Plane verifies repository equals PublicationTarget.repository and resolves links from kind plus number.

DeliveryTaskProposalProjection.description: One ordered planner task proposal sealed into reviewSetSha256. Approval promotes these exact fields with owner null and status pending; planner-supplied ownership and HTTP replacement task content are rejected.

taskProposals.description: Canonical order is part of reviewSetSha256 and is preserved during task promotion.

SolutionReviewProjection.description: Current validated solution review, including pending review content and the ordered task proposals sealed into reviewSetSha256. Human review has no ExecutionJob SessionBinding.

DeliveryStageSessionBindingProjection.description: A ProductSession/ExecutionJob binding remains visible before Worker/Codex attachment; a CodexThread is never present without its WorkerSession.

DeliveryStageProjection.description: Human review stages never receive an ExecutionJob SessionBinding. Every Codex StageRun has its ProductSession/ExecutionJob binding; only WorkerSession/CodexThread attachment may remain pending.

DeliveryAttentionProjection.description: Safe Attention projection. Canonical protocol context is never returned.

DeliveryEvidenceProjection.description: Evidence stores a bounded source reference, never copied runtime logs or command output.

FrozenCandidateSummaryProjection.description: Bounded current candidate identity. Changed paths, hunks, and diff bytes require a separate authorized detail endpoint.

StrongFlowDiagramExecutionNodeProjection.description: Execution state for one exact node in the current approved diagram.

path.description: Normalized repository-relative path from the exact current Candidate.

StrongFlowDiagramExecutionDetailsProject.description: Bounded current Candidate and cross-panel identities. Diff bytes and hunk content remain on authorized detail endpoints.

StrongFlowDiagramExecutionProjection.description: Same-cut execution impact and exact current cross-panel links for the approved StrongFlow diagrams.

DeliveryDetailProjection.description: StrongFlow detail read model. It is a closed projection, not a mutable Delivery entity.

CommandCompletedEnvelope.description: Shared completed-command envelope. Public responses use the command-discriminated CommandCompletedResponse union.

QueryResultEnvelope.description: Shared query-result envelope. Public responses use the query-discriminated QueryResultResponse union.

ChatInteractionBindingProjection.description: Complete public interaction binding. The Control Plane validates equality across every duplicated identity before accepting a decision.

ChatInputInteractionProjection.description: Secret-safe pending input projection. It excludes Worker envelopes, provider data, credentials, and raw tool payloads.

EnterpriseOrganizationPage.description: One bounded, cursor-bound page from a stable enterprise management snapshot.

EnterpriseMembershipPage.description: One bounded, cursor-bound page from a stable enterprise management snapshot.

EnterpriseProjectRepositoryPage.description: One bounded, cursor-bound page from a stable enterprise management snapshot.

EnterprisePolicyPage.description: One bounded, cursor-bound page from a stable enterprise management snapshot.

EnterpriseFleetPage.description: One bounded, cursor-bound page from a stable enterprise management snapshot.

EnterpriseUsagePage.description: One bounded, cursor-bound page from a stable enterprise management snapshot.

EnterpriseAuditPage.description: One bounded, cursor-bound page from a stable enterprise management snapshot.

EnterpriseIntegrationPage.description: One bounded, cursor-bound page from a stable enterprise management snapshot.

EnterpriseProjectRepositoryUpdatePayload.description: repositoryId is required exactly when kind is repository; the application rejects a mismatched pair.

configuration.description: Closed secret-safe integration settings. Credentials are referenced separately and URL queries/fragments are not accepted.

EnterpriseIntegrationUpdatePayload.description: Configuration contains secret-safe settings and credential references only; raw secrets are rejected.

EnterprisePolicyVersionSource.description: Authenticated source of one immutable policy version.

EnterprisePolicyVersionReference.description: Exact immutable policy version seal used for inheritance and relaxation authority.

childOverrideMode.description: Only an organization-scoped active policy may authorize explicit child relaxation.

EnterprisePolicyDefinition.description: Closed, secret-free policy rule manifest; condition bodies are stored and audited by their canonical digest.

EnterpriseServiceAccountProjection.description: Secret-free Service Account identity. Its API Token digests are never part of this projection.

EnterpriseExternalIdentityProjection.description: Secret-free external subject binding. Authentication maps it to one canonical User Actor.

EnterpriseApiTokenProjection.description: Secret-free API Token metadata. Raw token material and its SHA-256 verifier are never returned.

EnterpriseIdentityPage.description: One stable, bounded organization identity page; it never contains token verifier or raw token material.

EnterpriseIdentityUpdatePayload.description: Identity mutation. API Token callers generate the raw wwc_api token locally and submit only its SHA-256 verifier.

EnterprisePermission.description: Closed least-privilege permission vocabulary. There is no wildcard permission.

EnterpriseRoleAssignment.description: Exact role-version grant. Nullable time bounds represent a permanent grant; descendants is evaluated only inside the authenticated organization boundary.

EnterpriseRolePage.description: One bounded, cursor-bound page from a stable role-authority snapshot.

EnterpriseTeamPage.description: One bounded, cursor-bound page from a stable team-authority snapshot.

CollaborationActivityProjection.description: Durable collaboration activity reference. It contains no raw provider payload or credential material.

CollaborationPresenceUpdatePayload.description: online and away require a lease duration; offline requires null. The application rejects every other pair.

path.description: Normalized repository-relative path selected from the trusted Candidate diff.

CandidateFileProjection.description: Bounded secret-free file metadata rebuilt from the exact retained Candidate Git range.

CandidateAvailability.description: Authoritative candidate Git retention state. Released candidates retain display facts only.

readPageLimit.description: The delivery.get page.limit sealed into atCursor; independent from this Candidate-history page size.

CandidateHistoryListParameters.description: Exact append-only Candidate history cut for one Delivery.

CandidateHistoryItemProjection.description: One exact Candidate observed in the verified Delivery journal. Availability comes only from its durable retention receipt.

readPageLimit.description: The delivery.get page.limit sealed into atCursor.

CandidateHistoricalReviewGetParameters.description: Exact historical Candidate identity selected from candidate.list. Repository locator and Git revision remain server-owned.

CandidateHistoricalReviewProjection.description: Original Candidate-bound review facts from the verified append-only journal. These facts are historical display data and never authorize the current Delivery.

readPageLimit.description: The delivery.get page.limit sealed into atCursor; independent from this file-page size.

CandidateFilesListParameters.description: Exact current-Candidate file filters. Empty statuses means every status.

readPageLimit.description: The delivery.get page.limit sealed into atCursor.

CandidateDiffChunkProjection.description: One bounded base64 byte range from the exact per-file unified Git diff. The normalized path must select the trusted inventory; repository locators, caller Git selectors, and request bodies are excluded.

readPageLimit.description: The delivery.get page.limit sealed into atCursor.

EvidenceReadBinding.description: A stale-check selector for one Evidence already returned at the exact Delivery read cursor. No field is bearer authorization.

EvidenceArtifactProvenanceProjection.description: Public provenance only. Worker, lease, fence, object key, path, and credential facts stay server-owned.

artifactId.description: Artifact identity used only as a stale selector under exact Evidence authority.

EvidenceArtifactDescriptorProjection.description: Secret-safe immutable descriptor revalidated from the exact Evidence authority. Its id and digest are stale selectors, never bearer authorization.

EvidenceArtifactUnavailableProjection.description: The current producer retained no exact Evidence-to-Artifact authority, so no Artifact selector or storage detail is exposed.

EvidenceDetailProjection.description: Exact current Evidence details reconstructed from the accepted Delivery, terminal, and runtime authorities. Free-form logs are never treated as outcome or access authority.

artifactId.description: Artifact identity used only as a stale selector under exact Evidence authority.

EvidenceArtifactContentGetParameters.description: A bounded range request that repeats the exact Evidence and descriptor stale-checks. Artifact id and digest alone grant no access.

artifactId.description: Artifact identity used only as a stale selector under exact Evidence authority.

EvidenceArtifactContentUnavailableProjec.description: Closed response used when the producer did not persist an exact Evidence-to-Artifact link. It does not confirm whether the caller-supplied Artifact id exists.

EvidenceArtifactContentChunkProjection.description: One integrity-checked bounded byte range. Large logs require continuation; binary and unknown text are download-only base64.

ModelRouteAvailabilityStatus.description: Closed readiness status derived only by the server.

ModelRouteAvailabilityReason.description: Closed, secret-safe reason for the route or page readiness result.

ModelRouteAvailabilityProjection.description: One server-joined ModelRoute. It contains identities and display metadata only; Credential locators, secrets, and pool internals are excluded.

ModelRouteAvailabilityPage.description: Bounded exact-Repository ModelRoute availability. Parent settings/catalog sources and the Project-scoped request-pool invalidation authority are joined by the server and identified explicitly; the client never derives a cross-Scope subscription.

sessionCookie.name: wwc_session
sessionCookie.description: Same-origin Web and local Host session.

bootstrapProof.description: Short-window, write-only browser bootstrap proof accepted only by session creation.

get.description: Restores the current secret-free Actor and bounded authorized Scope set from the HttpOnly browser-session cookie.

post.description: Exchanges one short-window bootstrap proof from the Authorization header for an independent HttpOnly session cookie and its secret-free current context.

delete.description: Revokes the exact current browser-session cookie and clears it from the browser.

post.description: Checks authentication, scope, requestId replay identity, and expectedRevision before mutation. Identical retries return the stored original status and body; changed input with the same requestId returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.
Side-effect free. List cursors bind scope, query, filters, and snapshot; results order by snapshot, updatedAt, then ID.

400.description: INVALID_REQUEST, including an invalid or mismatched cursor

409.description: READ_CURSOR_EXPIRED; discard the complete partial StrongFlow snapshot and restart with delivery.get without atCursor
